# PUD Consultants

> PUD Consultants (Planning & Urban Development Consultants) is an urban planning, master planning, architecture and sustainable tourism consultancy founded in Cairo in 1966 by Prof. Dr. Abdallah Attia and led today by Prof. Dr. Amr Attia. Offices: Cairo, Riyadh and Dubai. It is not related to planned unit developments or public utility districts, which share the acronym PUD.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1966, Cairo, Egypt
- Founder: Prof. Dr. Abdallah Abdel Aziz Attia, architect and professor
- Leader: Prof. Dr. Amr Attia, Professor of Urban Planning at Ain Shams University, Eisenhower Fellow (Egypt 2007), Board Chairman of SHARE Egypt
- Offices: Cairo (Sheikh Zayed City and Heliopolis), Riyadh (Diplomatic Quarter and Al Nakheel), Dubai (Palm Jumeirah)
- Work: 192 documented projects in 11 countries, mostly Egypt and Saudi Arabia
- Partners include WATG, AECOM Arabia, Gillespies, Systematica, Dar Al-Handasah

## Services
- [Urban and regional planning](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/urban-and-regional-planning.html): We plan how cities and regions grow: land use, mobility, housing and infrastructure, aligned with national visions and tested with the people affected.
- [Master planning and urban design](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/master-planning-and-urban-design.html): From an empty site to a working district. We plan mixed-use destinations, communities and campuses with walkable streets, public space and phasing.
- [Sustainable tourism planning](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/sustainable-tourism-planning.html): Destinations that keep what visitors come for. We plan coasts, resorts and heritage sites that earn all year and protect their landscape and identity.
- [Cultural heritage planning](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/cultural-heritage-planning.html): Heritage is not a backdrop. We build it into the plan, so new development continues the story of a place instead of replacing it.
- [Architecture and interior design](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/architecture-and-interior-design.html): Buildings that belong to their place. Hotels, campuses, offices and homes shaped by climate, setting and the people who use them.
- [Landscape planning and design](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/landscape-planning-and-design.html): Parks, waterfronts and open space are where a plan meets daily life. We design them to be used, easy to reach and at home in their landscape.
- [Environment and sustainability](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/environment-and-sustainability.html): Low-carbon, climate-resilient planning and green infrastructure, from a Red Sea marine field station to WATG's Sharaan Nature Reserve master plan.
- [Infrastructure and mobility planning](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/infrastructure-and-mobility-planning.html): Streets, tunnels, stormwater and rail planned together with the city, so networks serve neighbourhoods instead of cutting through them.
- [Strategic advisory and development consultancy](https://www.pudconsultants.com/services/development-consultancy-and-strategic-advisory.html): Plans that can be built and paid for. We link vision to feasibility, investment strategy and development economics on large programmes.

## Guides
- [What is urban planning?](https://www.pudconsultants.com/insights/what-is-urban-planning.html): Urban planning decides how land in cities and regions is used, connected and looked after, so that people can live, work and move well.
- [What is master planning?](https://www.pudconsultants.com/insights/what-is-master-planning.html): A master plan shows how one defined area, a district, resort, campus or new city, will be organised and built in stages: its land, buildings, streets, open spaces and infrastructure.
- [What is sustainable tourism planning?](https://www.pudconsultants.com/insights/what-is-sustainable-tourism-planning.html): Sustainable tourism planning keeps visitor numbers, buildings and infrastructure in balance with local communities, culture and the environment, so a destination stays worth visiting.
- [Urban planning in Egypt: from the Nile Valley to the new coast and capital](https://www.pudconsultants.com/insights/urban-planning-in-egypt.html): Most of Egypt's people live on a small share of its land, along the Nile and Delta, so national planning has long pushed growth towards new communities, coasts and desert corridors.
- [Urban planning in Saudi Arabia: giga-projects, holy sites and regional plans](https://www.pudconsultants.com/insights/urban-planning-in-saudi-arabia.html): Saudi Arabia is planning at every scale at once: national land strategies, giga-project destinations, holy-site programmes and the growth of Riyadh, Jeddah and Makkah.

## Signature projects
- [Sumou Boulevard, New Cairo](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/somou-boulevard-new-cairo.html): Sumou Boulevard is a mixed-use development at the gate of Mostakbal City in New Cairo, for Paragon-Adeer.
- [Jabal Thabeer Park (Mina, Makkah)](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/jabal-thabeer-park.html): Landscape design for a 250,000 m2 hillside park at Mina beside the Jamarat Bridge in Makkah, with Gillespies, Studio 4215 and Systematica.
- [Kidana Al Khaif (Mina, Muzdalifah and Arafat)](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/kidana-al-khaif.html): Advisory and master planning for the holy sites of Mina (7.8 km2), Muzdalifah (11.9 km2) and Arafat (12.2 km2) in Makkah.
- [Pyramids Plateau Destination Master Plan](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/pyramids-plateau-destination-master-plan.html): Tourism master plan for the Giza Pyramids plateau, from Sphinx International Airport to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Memphis and its Necropolis.
- [AlUla Strategic Framework Plan](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/alula-strategic-framework-plan.html): County-wide strategic framework plan for the Royal Commission for AlUla, led by WATG with PUD as local partner.
- [Golden Gate](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/golden-gate-new-cairo.html): Golden Gate, a development in New Cairo, for Redcon, with WATG.
- [Regional Vision for the North Coast and Tourism Development Master Plan for Fuka-Matrouh](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/north-coast-regional-vision-fuka-matrouh.html): Regional vision and tourism development master plan for the Fuka-Matrouh sub-region of Egypt's North Coast.
- [Marina Matrouh Tourist Centre](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/marina-matrouh.html): The Marina Matrouh tourist centre on Egypt's North Coast, planned in phases from 1994 to 2004 for Samala and Alam Al-Roum Company for Urban.
- [Hilton Dahab Village Hotel](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/hilton-dahab-village-hotel.html): Hilton Dahab is a village hotel on the Gulf of Aqaba in Sinai, designed in 1991 for Misr Hotels Company and built in the mid-1990s.
- [Marina El Alamein](https://www.pudconsultants.com/projects/marina-el-alamein.html): Master planning, detailed design and site supervision for the 2,000 hectare Marina El Alamein tourist centre on Egypt's North Coast, for NUCA.
